entry.name: Animate
entry.label: Drift the nebula

entry.name: Speed
entry.label: Drift speed as a percentage, 25 to 300

entry.name: Twinkle
entry.label: Let a few stars breathe

entry.name: Meteors
entry.label: A shooting star every minute or two

entry.name: DayNight
entry.label: Deeper nights, softer days: the sky follows the wall clock

entry.name: Aurora
entry.label: An aurora on the deepest nights, once or twice an hour

entry.name: Celestials
entry.label: The moon in its true phase, the Milky Way, the evening star, a rare comet

entry.name: Southern
entry.label: Southern hemisphere: seasons flip and the moon waxes on the left

entry.name: Almanac
entry.label: A quiet line under the clock on special nights

entry.name: RealSky
entry.label: The actual bright stars, wheeling at sidereal rate

entry.name: Weather
entry.label: Fetch real weather from open-meteo.com and wear it

entry.name: WeatherLat
entry.label: Latitude for the weather, entered by hand

entry.name: SpaceWeather
entry.label: Fetch NOAA's Kp index; geomagnetic storms bring storm auroras

entry.name: WeatherLon
entry.label: Longitude for the weather, entered by hand

entry.name: BurnInGuard
entry.label: Wander static elements a few pixels to spare OLED panels

entry.name: Mode
entry.label: 0 = nebula only, 1 = nebula plus photo gallery

entry.name: GalleryFolder
entry.label: Folder the gallery reads images from

entry.name: Recursive
entry.label: Walk subfolders too (3 levels, 2000 images at most)

entry.name: DailyPhoto
entry.label: One deterministic photo per day instead of a rotation

entry.name: ShowCaptions
entry.label: Caption each photo with its cleaned-up file name

entry.name: Interval
entry.label: Seconds an image stays on screen

entry.name: Shuffle
entry.label: Play the folder in random order

entry.name: FitMode
entry.label: 0 = fit (never crop), 1 = fill (crop), 2 = pan and scan

entry.name: Backdrop
entry.label: Fills the empty bars in fit mode: 0 = nebula, 1 = blurred copy, 2 = dim

entry.name: FrameStyle
entry.label: 0 = plain lit tile, 1 = tile with a glow, 2 = rounded glass card

entry.name: UltrawideGallery
entry.label: On very wide screens, show two or three photos side by side

entry.name: ShowClock
entry.label: Show the day, date and time

entry.name: ClockPosition
entry.label: 0 = centre of the screen, 1 = top centre

entry.name: TimeFormat
entry.label: 0 = follow the locale, 1 = 12-hour, 2 = 24-hour
